``` {r setup}
every_nth <- function(x, nth, empty = TRUE, inverse = FALSE) 
{
  if (!inverse) {
    if(empty) {
      x[1:nth == 1] <- ""
      x
    } else {
      x[1:nth != 1]
    }
  } else {
    if(empty) {
      x[1:nth != 1] <- ""
      x
    } else {
      x[1:nth == 1]
    }
  }
}
dir.create("r_plots/objects", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
``` 

``` {r Table pRepare + helper functions}
my_pRepare <- function(x) { 
  
  x$variable <- factor(x$Genotype, levels=c("Col0", "xrn4", "xrn4_dne1"))
  x$Percent_co <- ifelse(x$Percent==0, 0.1/x$total*100, x$Percent)
  
  x$Uridylated <- as.numeric(x$Percent_co)
  x$NonUridylated <- as.numeric(100 - x$Percent_co)
  
  x$Rep_V <- factor(x$Rep, levels=c("Rep1", "Rep2", "Rep3"))
  x$Feature.name_V <- factor(x$Feature.name)
  return(x)
}

Table <- my_pRepare(Table_U)

nrow(Table)
length(unique(Table$Feature.name))
table(Table$variable)
table(Table$Rep_V)

# ---- Fitlering to have the same Feature.name in all Rep x Genotype combinations -----
filter_A_for_all_BC <- function(df) {
  # Extraire toutes les combinaisons distinctes de Genotype et Rep
  all_BC <- df %>%
    distinct(Genotype, Rep)
  
  # Pour chaque Feature.name, compter combien de combinaisons (B,C) il couvre
  valid_A <- df %>%
    distinct(Genotype, Rep, Feature.name) %>%
    group_by(Feature.name) %>%
    summarise(n_bc = n()) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Nombre total de combinaisons Genotype, Rep dans la table
  total_bc <- nrow(all_BC)
  
  # Garder les Feature.name qui ont toutes les combinaisons Genotype, Rep
  valid_A <- valid_A %>%
    filter(n_bc == total_bc) %>%
    pull(Feature.name)
  
  # Filtrer le df original pour garder uniquement les lignes avec ces A valides
  df %>% filter(Feature.name %in% valid_A)
}

table_glht <- function(x) {
  pq <- summary(x)$test
  mtests <- cbind(pq$coefficients, pq$sigma, pq$tstat, pq$pvalues)
  error <- attr(pq$pvalues, "error")
  colnames(mtests) <- c("Estimate", "Std.Error", "z.value", "p.value")
  return(mtests)
}
```

``` {r global glm no subsapling}
my_glm1 <- function(Data) {
  
  Data <- filter_A_for_all_BC(Data)
  set.seed(1)
  
  print("Model with only genotype as explanatory variable")
  model <- glm(cbind(Uridylated, NonUridylated) ~ variable + Rep_V + Feature.name_V,
               family = quasibinomial,
               data = Data)
  print("Summary of the model")
  print(summary(model))

  Test <- anova(model, test = "F")
  print("ANOVA: Results of the F test")
  print(Test)

  print("Confidence interval")
  model2 <- glm(cbind(Uridylated, NonUridylated) ~ variable - 1,
                family = quasibinomial,
                data = Data)
  print(plogis(confint(model2))) # CIs on log-odds and then transform to probabilities

 tuk_raw <- glht(model, mcp(variable = "Tukey"))
  tuk <- summary(tuk_raw)
  print("Tukey test:")
  print(tuk)
  
  cld_res <- cld(tuk)

  letters_vec <- cld_res$mcletters$Letters
  letters_df <- data.frame(
    Genotype = names(letters_vec),
    group    = as.character(letters_vec),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Odds ratio = probability of certain amount of transcripts getting Longer tails for each genotype
  # Odds ratios and CI on the contrasts
  coef  <- tuk$test$coef          # log-odds differences
  se    <- tuk$test$sigma         # standard errors
  pval  <- tuk$test$pvalues       # adjusted p-values
  
  ORs   <- exp(coef)
  tuk_ci <- confint(tuk_raw)$confint
  lower  <- exp(tuk_ci[, "lwr"])
  upper  <- exp(tuk_ci[, "upr"])
  
  OR_table <- data.frame(
  Contrast = names(coef),
  OR       = round(ORs,   3),
  CI_low   = round(lower, 3),
  CI_high  = round(upper, 3),
  p_adj    = signif(pval, 3),  # 3 significant digits, not 3 decimals
  row.names = NULL,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
    print(table(Data$variable))

  print("Odds ratios for Tukey contrasts:")
  print(OR_table) 
  
  
  # Building a data frame of letters per genotype to return to use later in boxplot
  letters_vec <- cld_res$mcletters$Letters
  letters_df <- data.frame(
    Genotype = names(letters_vec),
    group    = as.character(letters_vec),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  
 return(list(
    letters   = letters_df,
    OR_table  = OR_table
))

}
```

``` {r global glm + subsampling}
my_glm2 <- function(Data) {

  # Subsampling
    Data <- filter_A_for_all_BC(Data)
    #Data <- Data %>% group_by(variable, Rep) %>% sample_n(1000) %>% ungroup() 
    set.seed(1)
    keep_features <- sample(unique(Data$Feature.name), ((1000)))
    Data <- Data %>% filter(Feature.name %in% keep_features)
    # Checking if the same Feature.names are compared across reps and genotype
    check <- Data %>%
  distinct(Feature.name, Genotype, Rep) %>%
  count(Feature.name) %>%
  summarise(min_n = min(n), max_n = max(n))
  print(check)
    
  print("GLM with genotype, replicate and feature as explanatory variables")
  model <- glm(cbind(Uridylated, NonUridylated) ~ variable + Rep_V + Feature.name_V,
               family = quasibinomial,
               data = Data)
  print("Summary of the model")
  print(summary(model))

  Test <- anova(model, test = "F")
  print("ANOVA: Results of the F test")
  print(Test)

  print("Confidence interval")
  model2 <- glm(cbind(Uridylated, NonUridylated) ~ variable - 1,
                family = quasibinomial,
                data = Data)
  print(plogis(confint(model2))) # CIs on log-odds and then transform to probabilities

  tuk_raw <- glht(model, mcp(variable = "Tukey"))
  tuk <- summary(tuk_raw)
  print("Tukey test:")
  print(tuk)
  
  cld_res <- cld(tuk)

  letters_vec <- cld_res$mcletters$Letters
  letters_df <- data.frame(
    Genotype = names(letters_vec),
    group    = as.character(letters_vec),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Odds ratio = probability of certain amount of transcripts getting Uridylated tails for each genotype
  # Odds ratios and CI on the contrasts
  coef  <- tuk$test$coef          # log-odds differences
  se    <- tuk$test$sigma         # standard errors
  pval  <- tuk$test$pvalues       # adjusted p-values
  
  ORs   <- exp(coef)
  tuk_ci <- confint(tuk_raw)$confint
  lower  <- exp(tuk_ci[, "lwr"])
  upper  <- exp(tuk_ci[, "upr"])
  
  
    # Counts per genotype
  counts_df <- as.data.frame(table(Data$variable))
  colnames(counts_df) <- c("Genotype", "n_obs")

  # Merge letters and counts by Genotype
  letters_counts <- merge(letters_df, counts_df, by = "Genotype", all.x = TRUE)

  OR_table <- data.frame(
  Contrast = names(coef),
  OR       = round(ORs,   3),
  CI_low   = round(lower, 3),
  CI_high  = round(upper, 3),
  p_adj    = signif(pval, 3),  # 3 significant digits, not 3 decimals
  row.names = NULL,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
  # Prepare a combined export table:
  # Part 1: ORs (contrast-level)
  OR_export <- OR_table
  OR_export$type <- "contrast"

  # Part 2: letters + counts (genotype-level)
  letters_export <- letters_counts
  letters_export$Contrast <- letters_export$Genotype
  letters_export$OR       <- NA_real_
  letters_export$CI_low   <- NA_real_
  letters_export$CI_high  <- NA_real_
  letters_export$p_adj    <- NA_real_
  letters_export$type     <- "genotype"

  # Add missing columns to OR_export so both have same structure
  OR_export$Genotype <- NA_character_
  OR_export$group    <- NA_character_
  OR_export$n_obs    <- NA_integer_

  # Reorder columns consistently
  OR_export  <- OR_export[,  c("type","Contrast","Genotype","group","n_obs","OR","CI_low","CI_high","p_adj")]
  letters_export <- letters_export[, c("type","Contrast","Genotype","group","n_obs","OR","CI_low","CI_high","p_adj")]

  combined_table <- rbind(OR_export, letters_export)

  print("Combined OR + letters + counts table:")
  print(combined_table)
  
  return(list(
    letters        = letters_df,
    OR_table       = OR_table,
    combined_table = combined_table
  ))
}

res <- my_glm2(Table)

letters_df      <- res$letters
OR_table        <- res$OR_table
combined_table  <- res$combined_table

write.csv(OR_table, "r_tables/uridylation_ORs_Tukey.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

``` {r per transcript glm}

my_glm_test <- function(x) {
  
  Result_table_exp <- data.frame(Estimate=as.numeric(), Std.Error=as.numeric(), z.value=as.numeric(), p.value=as.numeric(), comparaison=as.character(), Feature.name=as.character(), padj=as.character(), Condition=as.character())
  
  for (t in unique(x$Condition))  {
    print(t)
    
    Result_table <- data.frame(Estimate=as.numeric(), Std.Error=as.numeric(), z.value=as.numeric(), p.value=as.numeric(), comparaison=as.character(), Feature.name=as.character())
    Selec_condition <- x[x$Condition==t,]
    Selec_condition <- filter_A_for_all_BC(Selec_condition)
    
    
    for (i in unique(Selec_condition$Feature.name)) {
      #message(i)
      PermRNA_percent_50_tailed_U_gene <- Selec_condition[Selec_condition$Feature.name==i, ]
      if (nrow(PermRNA_percent_50_tailed_U_gene) <= 2) {next}
      tryCatch({     
        Uri1 <- glm(cbind(Uridylated , NonUridylated ) ~ variable, family=quasibinomial, data=PermRNA_percent_50_tailed_U_gene)
        glht_obj <- summary(glht(Uri1 , mcp(variable="Tukey")))
        Tab <- as.data.frame(table_glht(glht_obj))
        Tab$comparaison <- row.names(Tab)
        Tab$Feature.name <- i
        rownames(Tab) <- NULL
        Result_table <- rbind(Result_table, Tab)
      }, error = function(e) {
        message("Skipping ", i, ": ", e$message)
      })
    }
    
    Result_table$padj <- p.adjust(Result_table$p.value, "BH")
    Result_table$Condition <- t
    Result_table_exp <- rbind(Result_table_exp, Result_table)
    
  }
  
  return(Result_table_exp)
}

Stat <- my_glm_test(Table)

length(unique(Stat$Feature.name))

Stat$diff <- "no-sign"
Stat[Stat$padj<=0.05,]$diff <- "sign"

Stat$Change <- "no-change"
Stat[Stat$Estimate<0,]$Change <- "decrease"
Stat[Stat$Estimate>0,]$Change <- "increase"

Stat$diff <- as.factor(Stat$diff)
Stat$Change <- as.factor(Stat$Change)

Count_ofDUgenes <- Stat %>% group_by(comparaison, Condition, diff, Change, .drop=FALSE) %>%
  summarise(number=n())  %>%
  group_by(comparaison, Condition) %>%
  mutate(total=sum(number), Percent=100*number/sum(number))

Diff_uri_transcripts <- Stat[Stat[["diff"]] == "sign" & Stat[["Change"]] == "increase", ]
length(unique(Diff_uri_transcripts))

Count_ofDUgenes$comparaison <- factor(Count_ofDUgenes$comparaison, levels=c("xrn4 - Col0", "xrn4_dne1 - Col0", "xrn4_dne1 - xrn4"))
Count_ofDUgenes_diff <- Count_ofDUgenes[Count_ofDUgenes$diff=="sign",]


write.table(Count_ofDUgenes_diff, "r_tables/Countofdifferentially_uridylatedmRNA_full_pipeline.txt", sep='\t', row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
```

```{r combined_boxplot_global_vs_diff, fig.width=14, fig.height=5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

#-----------------------------
# 1. Prepare the two datasets
#-----------------------------
Table_filtered <- filter_A_for_all_BC(Table)
global_df <-Table_filtered %>%
  dplyr::select(Genotype, Rep, Percent, Feature.name) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Subset = "Global",
    Rep = factor(as.character(Rep), levels = c("Rep1", "Rep2", "Rep3"))
  )

diff_df <- MUG_Table_U_xrn4_xrn4_dne1%>%
  dplyr::select(Genotype, Rep, Percent, Feature.name) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Subset = "Differential",
    Rep = factor(as.character(Rep), levels = c("Rep1", "Rep2", "Rep3"))
  )

combined_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(global_df, diff_df)

# make sure character/factor columns are clean
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Genotype = as.character(Genotype),
    Rep = factor(as.character(Rep), levels = c("Rep1", "Rep2", "Rep3")),
    Subset = factor(as.character(Subset), levels = c("Global", "Differential")),
    xgroup = factor(
      paste(Subset, Rep, sep = "_"),
      levels = c(
        "Global_Rep1", "Global_Rep2", "Global_Rep3",
        "Differential_Rep1", "Differential_Rep2", "Differential_Rep3"
      )
    )
  )

#-----------------------------
# 2. Add sample size labels
#-----------------------------
# These are total counts per genotype and subset
n_df <- combined_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genotype, xgroup) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y = 47,
    lab = paste0("n = ", n)
  )

#-----------------------------
# 3. Plot
#-----------------------------

box_combined <- ggplot(
  combined_df,
  aes(x = xgroup, y = Percent, fill = Genotype, color = Genotype)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    width = 0.6,
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.4,
    notch = FALSE
  ) +
  stat_summary(
  fun = median,
  geom = "text",
  aes(label = round(after_stat(y), 2)),
  position = position_nudge(y = 1),
  color = "red",
  size = 4,
  show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Genotype, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 50),
    breaks = seq(0, 50, 10)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("R1", "R2", "R3", "R1", "R2", "R3")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genotype_colors, breaks = names(genotype_colors)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = genotype_colors, breaks = names(genotype_colors)) +
  labs(
    title = "Uridylation: global vs more uridylated differential transcripts",
    x = NULL,
    y = "% uridylation"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 2, label = "Global", size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 5, y = 2, label = "Differential", size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  # geom_text(
  # data = n_df,
  # aes(x = xgroup, y = y, label = lab),
  # inherit.aes = FALSE,
  # size = 5,
  # color = "black"
  # ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

box_combined

saveRDS(box_combined, "r_plots/objects/uridylation_combined_box.rds")
ggsave("r_plots/uridylation_box_combined.pdf", box_combined, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300, scale = 1.3)
ggsave("r_plots/uridylation_box_combined.svg", box_combined, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300, scale = 1.3)
```
